verbs.name: debug.screenshot
verbs.description: DEBUG (verification primitive): capture a SERVER-SIDE screenshot of the actual primary display (or a chosen `monitor`/`window`) to a PNG, returned inline as base64. Unlike `ui.screenshot` (which relays to the connected WebView and fails with no UI client), this grabs the REAL screen via the in-process OS recorder (ScreenCaptureKit/macOS, WGC/Windows, portal/Linux) — so it works HEADLESS / regardless of UI-client state, the tool for visually verifying the app, dialogs and right-click menus while driving cutd over the debug API. Implemented as a sub-second screen capture whose first frame is extracted to PNG. No project required; no audio, no input capture.

monitor.description: 1-based monitor index from screen_record.doctor's `monitors` (omit = primary display).

window.description: Capture one application window by its opaque live native screen_record.doctor.windows[].id (Windows/macOS). The identity is revalidated at capture time; title text is never accepted. Omit for the whole display.

inline.description: Return the PNG inline as base64 `png_base64` (default true). false = return the path only.

verbs.result: {path, width, height, mime:"image/png", png_base64?, bytes?} — the screenshot file path + pixel dimensions + (when inline, the default) the base64-encoded PNG so an agent can SEE the result. not_found if no screen-capture backend is compiled for this build/OS.
